title: Orthodontic Benefit Riders — Covered Treatment Types by Rider
content:
**Which kinds of orthodontic treatment each Cascade Ortho Rider covers.** The coverage grid below applies to the Orthodontic Benefit Riders.

| Rider | Comprehensive clear aligners covered on the same terms as fixed braces | Limited or interceptive (phase I) treatment covered | Most planned months for a limited or interceptive case to be paid as such |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 1000 | no | no | 0 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 1500 | yes | no | 0 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Child 2000 | yes | yes | 12 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 1500 | yes | no | 0 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 2000 | yes | yes | 12 |
| Cascade Ortho Rider Family 3000 | yes | yes | 12 |

Where limited or interceptive treatment is covered, it counts toward the lifetime maximum. A limit of 0 months goes with riders on which limited treatment is not covered.

## Terms the same on every rider

| Term | All six riders |
|---|---|
| Retainers and retention visits | part of the case fee, with no separate benefit |
| Second course of comprehensive treatment after a completed case | not covered |
| Pre-orthodontic records and diagnostic casts | paid inside the case benefit, not separately |
| Pre-treatment estimate of the case before banding | recommended |

### Questions this grid answers

**Is a limited case planned for 10 months paid as limited treatment on the Cascade Ortho Rider Child 2000?** Yes. Limited treatment is covered on that rider and 10 months does not exceed 12. A plan of 13 months would exceed the 12-month limit.

**Does the Cascade Ortho Rider Child 1000 cover clear aligners?** No. It is the only rider without clear-aligner coverage.
